accepted.s: NICDC was formerly known as which of the following organisations?
accepted.x: NICDC was formerly known as the Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor Development Corporation (DMICDC).
accepted.tq: Direct recall of an institutional name change.
accepted.sec: NICDC - structure, greenfield industrial smart cities

accepted.s: NICDC was incorporated in which month and year?
accepted.x: NICDC was incorporated in January 2008.
accepted.tq: Numerical and date recall using closely spaced institutional milestones.
accepted.sec: NICDC - structure, greenfield industrial smart cities

accepted.s: Which department and ministry are associated with NICDC?
o: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
Department of Heavy Industry, Ministry of Steel
accepted.x: NICDC is associated with DPIIT under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct ministry and department rather than a neighbouring authority.
accepted.sec: NICDC - structure, greenfield industrial smart cities

accepted.s:
With reference to the institutional structure of industrial corridor development, consider the following statements:
1. NICDIT functions as an apex trust for funding nodes.
2. The Budget Estimate for NICDIT funding in 2026–27 is ₹3,000 crore.
3. NICDIT is described as a department of the Ministry of Finance.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: NICDIT is an apex trust for funding nodes, with ₹3,000 crore provided in the 2026–27 Budget Estimate. It is not described as a Department of the Ministry of Finance.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong institutional description and retain the correct structure and figure.
accepted.sec: NICDC - structure, greenfield industrial smart cities

accepted.s: Which pair of operational greenfield industrial smart cities is correctly matched with its State?
accepted.x: The operational cities identified are Dholera in Gujarat and Shendra-Bidkin in Maharashtra.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure location pair in a location-based matching question.
accepted.sec: NICDC - structure, greenfield industrial smart cities

accepted.s: The combined investment associated with the operational cities Dholera and Shendra-Bidkin is reported as approximately:
accepted.x: The investment associated with Dholera and Shendra-Bidkin is ₹2.02 lakh crore.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a lakh-crore investment figure from corridor and scheme outlays.
accepted.sec: NICDC - structure, greenfield industrial smart cities

o: New greenfield industrial smart cities including Orvakal, Kopparthy and Krishnapatnam
Only the Sri City dry-port proposal
The creation of 14 Coastal Economic Zones
The VCIC policy loan of US$125 million

accepted.s: BHAVYA, announced for 2026, stands for:
o: Bharat High-value Advancement and Yuva Authority
Bharat Advanced Manufacturing and Value Addition Yojana
accepted.x: BHAVYA stands for Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojana.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about BHAVYA:
1. It has an allocation of ₹33,660 crore.
2. It covers FY27–FY32.
3. It aims to establish 100 plug-and-play industrial parks.
4. It is implemented by NICDC through an SPV of NICDIT and a State agency.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements correctly describe BHAVYA: its ₹33,660 crore allocation, FY27–FY32 period, 100 parks and implementation structure.
accepted.tq: Test a complete scheme profile through an all-statements option.

accepted.s: Which State is described as having nodes on all three of the VCIC, CBIC and HBIC national corridors?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh is described as the only State with nodes on the VCIC, CBIC and HBIC national corridors.

accepted.s: The total ADB assistance for the VCIC is US$840 million. Which of the following correctly represents its components?
o: Policy loan US$840 million with no separate project loan or GoAP contribution
Policy loan US$500 million, project loan US$215 million and GoAP contribution US$125 million
Policy loan US$215 million, project loan US$125 million and GoAP contribution US$500 million
Policy loan US$125 million, project loan US$500 million and GoAP contribution US$215 million
accepted.x: VCIC financing comprises an ADB policy loan of US$125 million, an ADB project loan of US$500 million and a GoAP contribution of US$215 million.
accepted.tq: Split the total into its component figures instead of relying on the aggregate alone.
accepted.sec: AP corridors and SEZs - VCIC funding, CBIC/HBIC nodes, Sri City, Vizag and Kakinada SEZs

accepted.s: Which of the following is the correct set of VCIC nodes in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The VCIC nodes are Visakhapatnam, Chittoor through the Srikalahasti-Yerpedu area, and Kopparthy.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct node list while separating it from CBIC and HBIC nodes.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the sectoral orientation of the VCIC?
o: Northern Andhra Pradesh—metallurgy, pharmaceuticals, petrochemicals and IT; Southern Andhra Pradesh—food processing, leather and automobiles
Northern Andhra Pradesh—only information technology; Southern Andhra Pradesh—only port services
Northern Andhra Pradesh—textiles and tourism; Southern Andhra Pradesh—coal and steel
Northern Andhra Pradesh—food processing, leather and automobiles; Southern Andhra Pradesh—metallurgy and pharmaceuticals
accepted.x: The northern part is associated with metallurgy, pharmaceuticals, petrochemicals and IT, while the southern part focuses on food processing, leather and automobiles.
accepted.tq: Use the reversed-comparison trap to distinguish northern and southern sectoral profiles.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about notified SEZs in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: There were 33 notified SEZs in 2023, of which 10 were developed by NICDC.
There were 47 or more notified SEZs in 2023, of which 10 were developed by APIIC.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the Kakinada SEZ project?
o: A greenfield industrial city at Orvakal with 2,621 acres
A greenfield port developed by GMR Kakinada Gateway, with 16 MTPA capacity and a cost of ₹2,123 crore
A port-led SEZ under Sagarmala with a capacity of 33 MTPA and a cost of ₹840 million
A dry port at Sri City with 3,213 acres and a cost of ₹1,264 crore

accepted.s: The Sagarmala National Perspective Plan proposed Coastal Economic Zones under which pillar?
accepted.x: The Sagarmala National Perspective Plan, formulated in 2016, proposed Coastal Economic Zones under its port-led industrialisation pillar.
accepted.tq: Link a programme with its specific policy pillar.
accepted.sec: Coastal Economic Zones - Sagarmala linkage

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Coastal Economic Zones:
1. They involve industrial clusters and SEZs near ports.
2. Fourteen Coastal Economic Zones were identified.
3. Their concept is linked with port-led industrialisation under Sagarmala.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: CEZs involve port-proximate industrial clusters and SEZs, 14 were identified, and they were proposed under Sagarmala's port-led industrialisation pillar.
accepted.tq: Confirm the complete concept through three linked policy statements.
accepted.sec: Coastal Economic Zones - Sagarmala linkage

accepted.s: Integration of industrial corridors with Sagarmala is intended primarily to:
o: Replace all SEZs with free trade zones
Transfer industrial corridors to State governments
accepted.x: The integration of corridors with Sagarmala is intended to reduce logistics costs.
accepted.tq: Identify the stated policy objective rather than an exaggerated consequence.
accepted.sec: Coastal Economic Zones - Sagarmala linkage

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT identified as a criticism or debate concerning SEZs and industrial policy?
o: Land acquisition, including the Nandigram controversy
Guaranteed expansion of employment in every notified SEZ
accepted.x: Land acquisition, revenue loss, under-used land and WTO-inconsistent export subsidies are identified criticisms. Guaranteed employment expansion in every SEZ is not listed as a criticism.
accepted.tq: Find the option that does not belong to the stated criticism set.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The criticism that SEZ incentives may be WTO-inconsistent relates primarily to:
accepted.x: One criticism is that export subsidies associated with SEZs may be inconsistent with WTO obligations.
accepted.tq: Match the international trade concern with its precise subject.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which recent policy change concerns sales by SEZ units in the domestic market?
o: SEZ units are prohibited from selling any output in India
SEZ units may sell domestically only after conversion into CEZs
SEZ units must transfer all domestic sales to NICDIT
SEZ units may sell in India at concessional tax under the 2026 Budget
accepted.x: The 2026 Budget permitted SEZ units to sell in India at concessional tax.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a current policy relaxation from an absolute prohibition.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly associates the current-relevance items with their reported dates?
o: BHAVYA parks portal—9 June 2026; Sri City dry port—July 2026; SEZ-to-DTA concessional sales—April 2026
BHAVYA parks portal—April 2026; Sri City dry port—9 June 2026; concessional sales—July 2026
BHAVYA parks portal—July 2026; Sri City dry port—April 2026; concessional sales—9 June 2026
accepted.x: The BHAVYA parks portal was reported on 9 June 2026, the Sri City dry-port development in July 2026, and SEZ-to-DTA concessional sales in April 2026.
accepted.tq: Match each current-affairs development with its date rather than treating them as one event.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Under the VCIC 2035 targets for Andhra Pradesh, which of the following combinations is correct?
o: Manufacturing output ₹4.20 trillion, 33% women in manufacturing and 24x7 power
Manufacturing output ₹2.02 trillion, 24% women in manufacturing and 33-hour power supply
Manufacturing output ₹840 million, 24% women in manufacturing and 12x7 power
Manufacturing output ₹33,660 crore, 35% women in manufacturing and 18x7 power
accepted.x: The VCIC 2035 targets are manufacturing output of ₹4.20 trillion, 33% participation of women in manufacturing and 24x7 power.
accepted.tq: Read the three-part target as a combined policy package and reject swapped figures.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
